newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan 14-day NCD average yield at 6.45 pct.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan 14-day NCD average yield at 6.45 pct.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank issued T$5 billion in 14-day negotiable certificates of deposit on Saturday at an average yield of 6.45 percent, a central bank official said.
The issues coincide with a renewed technology-led bull run in Taiwan's stock market following a brief correction.
Taiwan's benchmark stock index closed at a seven-year high 9,869.25 on Saturday, a gain of 60.34 points or 0.62 percent on a turnover of T$184.7 billion.

Central bank chief Sheu Yuan-dong has said the bank would not adjust monetary policy merely to cool Taiwan's red-hot stock market, saying such moves were no "cure all" in the face of concerns of overheating.

But the central bank's repeated issuance of NCDs has been seen widely as a bid to dampen the sizzling stock market by slowing what have been huge flows of liquidity out of the money market and into the bourse.
